_comment: Shared config for the real-data pipeline (real/tools/*.py) -- one file instead of the same numbers duplicated in three scripts, same reasoning as convert_dem_tile.js exporting TILE_SIZE/GRID_RANGE for the synthetic prototype's own tools to share.
region: Remagen / Rhein-Schleife (Erpel, Bad Honnef, Sinzig, Linz am Rhein)
crsComment: UTM zone 32N -- correct zone for this longitude band (6E-12E), true metre distances at this scale without the projection distortion a lat/lon-as-metres shortcut would introduce.
originComment: SW corner of the working area in UTM32N metres, rounded down to a clean 1000m -- world (0,0) in the tile-local coordinate system every tool/JSON file below uses. worldX = utmEasting - originUTM.x, worldZ = utmNorthing - originUTM.y (north = +Z).
gridComment: tx runs 0..6, tz runs 0..7 -- covers UTM X 361000..389000, Y 5589000..5621000, comfortably containing the full bboxLonLat with margin on every side.

ludendorffBridgeEast.label: Erpel bridgehead (east bank, below the Erpeler Ley)
